title: Shelter Expansion Adds 160 beds for Unhoused Women and Single Women with Children
description: SAN DIEGO—Addressing the shortage of available shelter beds for unhoused women and women with children in the City of San Diego, a public-private collaborative effort has added 160 beds at Rachel’s Promise Center for Women and Children (Rachel’s Promise), a shelter program funded by the City of San Diego and operated by Catholic Charities, Diocese of San Diego through a contract with the San Diego Housing Commission (SDHC).
